hooks.prompt:
A Java file was just modified. The changed file path is available in the tool input: $ARGUMENTS

Extract the file_path from the JSON input. If the file ends with .java, run the code-reviewer subagent on it. Check for: correctness (logic bugs, off-by-one errors), LibGDX best practices (no render-loop allocations, proper Disposable lifecycle, camera usage), memory safety (every Disposable disposed), math accuracy (angle unit mixing, coordinate system — origin bottom-left Y-up, world 1280×720), constants that should be in Constants.java, and math formulas that should be in GameMath.java. If the file does NOT end with .java, do nothing and exit silently.
hooks.statusMessage: Running code review on changed Java file...
